Hadhrat Umar (RA) then started to weep and said, "I seek forgiveness from Allaah! I shall never do it again." Thereafter, Hadhrat Umar (RA) was never seen giving preference to a person from the Quraysh over a person from the Ansaar. [^1]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Honours Hadhrat Sa'd bin Ubaadah (RA)

Hadhrat Zaid bin Thaabit (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Sa'd bin Ubaadah (RA) once visited Rasulullaah ﷺ with his son. When he greeted with Salaam, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Here and here." Rasulullaah ﷺ then made Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) sit on his right and said, "Welcome to the Ansaar. Welcome to the Ansaar." (Out of respect for Rasulullaah ﷺ,) Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) then made his son stand in front of Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ told the youth to sit and when he did, Rasulullaah ﷺ bade him to sit closer to him. The youth came closer and started kissing the hands and feet of Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "I am from the Ansaar and from the children of the Ansaar." Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) remarked, "May Allaah honour you as you have honoured us." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Verily Allaah has honoured you before I could honour you. However, after I die, you shall soon see that others will be given preference over you. I urge you to be patient until you meet me at the pond (of Kowthar)." [^2]

Hadhrat Anas (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Jareer (RA) served him greatly as they travelled together on a journey. Hadhrat Jareer (RA) said, "I have seen the Ansaar do great services to Rasulullaah ﷺ and I therefore serve every person from the Ansaar whom I see." [^3]
Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob Ansaari (RA) Stays with Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA), Who Places himself at his Service

Hadhrat Habeeb bin Abi Thaabit narrates that Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob Ansaari (RA) once went to Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) to complain about a debt he had (asking Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) for financial assistance). However, Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob Ansaari (RA) did not receive the desired response, but rather received a response that was unpleasant.
